gui.open2online.firewall.warning: Don't use this if everything is working fine!
gui.open2online.firewall.whenToUse: This should only be used when there are no errors publishing the server, but no one can connect to it. Make sure it's necessary.
gui.open2online.firewall.whatItDoes: When you click on "Recreate Rules" button, the old Minecraft firewall rules will be deleted and new correct ones will be created.
gui.open2online.firewall.requirements: This only works on Windows. Recreating firewall rules requires administrator rights.
gui.open2online.port.invalid: Port must be a whole number between 0 and 65535
gui.open2online.maxPlayers.invalid: Max players must be a whole number above 0

chat.open2online.error.publishFailed: Unable to host online game. Try changing the port
chat.open2online.error.autoAllFailed: Failed to open the port with every library. Try changing the port
chat.open2online.warn.usingLastKnownIP: Showing the last known address, it may be out of date
tooltip.open2online.recreateFirewallRule: This may help if no one can connect to your server.
